Clear shot of the base and body without glare to check for rust or dents.
response.reason: The item is a standard 47kg LPG gas cylinder, identifiable by type and partial brand text, but with no proof of emptiness, valve integrity, or certification date, so it must be priced at the worst-case condition (uncertified, unconfirmed empty, cosmetic wear).
